mal:area.name: MC
mal:area.comment: This section details the MC services, the structures used by the services are detailed in section 4. Both the services and structures are defined in terms of the MO MAL, which is defined in [2], so it is possible to deploy them over any supported protocol and message transport. The services defined here are also specified in terms of the COM, which is defined in [3]. To aid comprehension, several tables are included for each service and operation definition. The table formats are briefly described in section 1.6.3.2 and are the same as those used for the specification of the MO COM services in [3]. All service specifications in this document are part of the MC area, which has a short form number of '4'.

mal:service.name: Action
mal:service.comment: The action service allows consumers to request execution of actions and to subsequently monitor the execution progress of these actions via the monitorExecution PUB-SUB operation. A consumer requests execution by calling the executeAction operation. The provider validates the request, creates and archives the ExecutionRequest object, assigns it a unique executionId, and returns that id in the response. The provider then reports execution progress by publishing monitorExecution notifications and storing ExecutionStatus COM objects in the archive. Once the action execution details have been checked and execution started, the executeAction operation completes whilst the execution of the action possibly continues (depends on the actual action). The action service defines three types of objects: ActionDefinition (holds the name, description, and argument list of an action), ExecutionRequest (holds the argument values submitted for a specific execution), and ExecutionStatus (holds the progress status of each stage of an execution).
mal:service.mal:documentation:
The action service shall provide:
  1. the capability for monitoring the execution progress of actions;
  2. the capability for submitting actions for execution;
  3. the capability for listing the numeric identifiers for the action definitions.
The list of actions that are supported by the action service shall be declared when deploying that service. Each action execution request shall include:
  1. the action definition numeric identifier;
  2. the ordered list of action arguments.
The provider shall return the action execution numeric identifier (executionId) in the response.
The executeAction operation shall be used to request execution of a new action execution on the provider.
The definitions of the actions shall be represented as ActionDefinition COM objects.

The source link of the ActionDefinition object should be the object that caused it to be created, most likely a COM OperationActivity object or an operator login in the case of off-line editors being used.
Executions of an action that are submitted to a provider using the executeAction operation shall be represented as ExecutionRequest COM object.
The id for an ExecutionRequest object shall be assigned by the provider and returned to the consumer as the executionId in the executeAction response.
The ExecutionRequest object shall use the related link to indicate which ActionDefinition object it uses.
ActionDefinition objects should be stored in the COM archive.
Upon accepting an action request, the provider shall create and store the ExecutionRequest object in the COM archive before beginning execution.
Each execution stage of an action shall be reported by publishing a monitorExecution notification and storing an ExecutionStatus COM object in the archive.
An ExecutionStatus object shall be created for each execution stage reached. It is implementation specific when a progress step is reached.
If an execution stage fails, the success field of the published monitorExecution notification and the corresponding ExecutionStatus object shall be set to FALSE.
ExecutionStatus objects shall be stored in the COM archive.
The ExecutionStatus object shall use the related link to point to the ExecutionRequest it belongs to.
The fields of the ExecutionStatus object shall match the corresponding fields published in the monitorExecution notification for the same stage.

mal:pubsubIP.name: monitorExecution
mal:pubsubIP.comment: The monitorExecution operation allows a consumer to subscribe for updates on the execution progress of actions.
mal:pubsubIP.mal:documentation: When an execution stage of an action is reached, the service provider shall publish an execution progress update.

The service provider shall publish the execution progress update with subscription keys corresponding to the definitionId, executionId, and actionCategory of the executing action. The stageType shall be included in the published message body.

A service consumer may subscribe to updates for a specific action definition, or for all action definitions by using the wildcard value in the definitionId field. The definitionId key shall be the id of the ActionDefinition object.

A service consumer may subscribe to updates for a specific action execution, or for all action executions by using the wildcard value in the executionId field. The executionId key shall be the id of the execution of an action.
A service consumer may subscribe to updates for a specific action category, or for all categories by using the wildcard value in the actionCategory field.
If the execution stage did not complete successfully, the success field of the published message shall be set to FALSE.
The stageType field shall be set to START when the action begins execution, to PROGRESS for each intermediate progress stage, and to END when the action completes execution.
The step field shall be set to the current progress step number for PROGRESS stage updates, and shall be NULL for START and END stage updates.

mal:field.name: definitionId
mal:field.comment: The id of the action definition being executed.

mal:field.name: executionId
mal:field.comment: The id of the ExecutionRequest being executed.

mal:field.name: actionCategory
mal:field.comment: The category of the action.

mal:field.name: stageType
mal:field.comment: The lifecycle stage of the execution update.

mal:field.name: success
mal:field.comment: Indicates whether the execution stage completed successfully.

mal:field.name: step
mal:field.comment: The progress step number within the action execution. Null for START and END stages.

mal:field.name: comment
mal:field.comment: An optional comment providing additional details about the execution stage.

mal:requestIP.name: executeAction
mal:requestIP.comment: The executeAction operation allows a consumer to request execution of an action on the provider. The execution of the action is asynchronous and therefore the executeAction operation may return before the action execution has been completed.
mal:requestIP.mal:documentation: If the definitionId of the supplied executionRequest field does not match a known ActionDefinition object then an UNKNOWN error shall be returned.

The size of the argumentValues list of the executionRequest field shall be compared to the size of the argument list in the matched ActionDefinition object and an INVALID error shall be returned if they are not the same.

If the executionRequest field contains an argumentIds value then this shall be compared to the same field in the matched ActionDefinition object and must be the same size and contain the same values, an INVALID error shall be returned if this is not the case.
If the supplied argument values do not match the attribute type specified in the action definition then an INVALID error shall be returned.
A service provider may apply some deployment specific checks to the action execution and can return an INVALID error if they fail.
If an error is raised then no action shall be executed.
The RESPONSE shall return the provider-assigned executionId once the action has been accepted for execution but before execution starts.

mal:field.name: executionRequest
mal:field.comment: The argument values and related information of the action to be executed.

mal:field.name: executionId
mal:field.comment: The provider-assigned id of the execution of an action. Used as the executionId subscription key in monitorExecution notifications.

mal:errorRef.comment: The list sizes held in the ExecutionRequest do not match the argument definitions or it contains one or more invalid argument values. If the two lists are not the same length then the extra information field shall contain the first index of the element in the largest list which does not have corresponding element in the other list.

mal:extraInformation.comment: The extra information field contains a list of the indexes of the erroneous values from the originating list supplied.

mal:errorRef.comment: Submitted action definition is unknown.

mal:requestIP.name: listDefinition
mal:requestIP.comment: The listDefinition operation allows a consumer to request the ids of the ActionDefinition objects for the supported actions of the provider.
mal:requestIP.mal:documentation: The request may contain the wildcard value of '*' to return all supported ActionDefinition objects.
The wildcard value should be checked for first, if found no other checks of supplied identifiers shall be made.
If a provided identifier does not include a wildcard and does not match an existing ActionDefinition object then this operation shall fail with an UNKNOWN error.
The returned list shall maintain the same order as the submitted list unless the wildcard value was included in the request.

mal:field.name: actionNames
mal:field.comment: The list of action names to retrieve the ActionDefinition ids for.

mal:field.name: ids
mal:field.comment: The list of ids matching the ActionDefinitions.

mal:errorRef.comment: One of the supplied identifiers is unknown.

mal:extraInformation.comment: A list of the indexes of the error values shall be contained in the extra information field.

com:objects.comment: Action definitions, execution requests, and execution statuses are represented as COM objects.

com:sourceObject.comment: The object that caused it to be created, for example, a COM OperationActivity
The object that caused it to be created, most likely a COM OperationActivity object if created by the executeAction operation

com:archiveUsage.comment: Action definition, execution request, and execution status objects are stored in the COM archive.

mal:service.name: Parameter
mal:service.comment:
The parameter service allows the user to subscribe to parameter value report and optionally be able to set new values. A single PUBSUB operation is provided for monitoring and publishing of parameter values. A parameter value also contains a calculation of the validity of the parameter, the flow chart for this calculation is provided in Figure 3-3: validity calculation flow chart
This standard supports the concept of non-standard invalidity states but the meaning and calculation of these is outside the scope of this standard. The generation of value reports can be controlled using the enableGeneration operation. The parameter service does not include any value checking, this is delegated to the check service. Parameter definitions are maintained using the operations defined in this service but storage of definitions is delegated to the COM archive.
mal:service.mal:documentation:
The parameter service shall provide:
  1. the capability for periodic reporting of predefined parameter values;
  2. the capability for setting the raw parameter value of a set of parameters;
  3. the capability for requesting the current value of a set of parameters;
  4. the capability for controlling reporting of the parameter values;
  5. the capability for maintaining the list of parameter definitions.
Each parameter value report shall contain:
  1. The validity of the parameter value;
  2. The raw value of the parameter;
  3. The converted value of the parameter, if applicable.
The validity of parameter shall be calculated against validity criteria in the parameter definition. It shall be possible to update, delete, and add parameter definitions. The list of the parameters definitions may be requested.

The generation of reports of the parameter shall be controlled by the generationEnabled Boolean value in the ParameterDefinition. Setting the generationEnabled field to TRUE shall enable generation of reports for a specific parameter. If a parameter is required to send periodic reports then the time between these reports shall be controlled using the reportInterval Duration value in the ParameterDefinition. A reportInterval value of '0' shall mean no periodic reports shall be sent; reports must be triggered by another implementation-specific mechanism in this case. The generationEnabled values can be set by using the enableGeneration operation. The generationEnabled and reportInterval values can be set by using the updateDefinition operation. For onboard parameters, the interval should be a multiple of the minimum sampling interval of those parameters. If an interval that is not supported by the provider is requested, then an INVALID error shall be returned, and the change rejected. If the parameter is periodic and reported via a periodic aggregation, and a new report has not been received in the aggregation period, then the validity shall be set to EXPIRED by setting the ParameterValue validityState field to '1'. If the parameter raw value cannot be obtained, or calculated for synthetic parameters, then the validity state shall be INVALID_RAW by setting the ParameterValue validityState field to '2' and the rawValue set to NULL. If the validityExpression field is NULL, or the validity expression evaluates to TRUE, and the ParameterDefinition either does not contain a conversion or the conversion is successful, then the validity state shall be set to VALID by setting the ParameterValue validityState field to '0'. If the validityExpression field is NULL, or the validity expression evaluates to TRUE, and the conversion of the parameter value fails (for example an unexpected value for a discrete conversion), then the validity state shall be INVALID_CONVERSION by setting the ParameterValue validityState field to '3'. If the validityExpression field is not NULL and the parameters used to determine the expression are not VALID, then the validity state shall be set to UNVERIFIED by setting the ParameterValue validityState field to '4'. If the validityExpression field is not NULL and the validity expression evaluates to FALSE, then the validity state shall be set to INVALID by setting the ParameterValue validityState field to '5'. If the validity of the parameter is INVALID_CONVERSION then the convertedValue of the ParameterValue shall be set to NULL. If the validity of the parameter is either UNVERIFIED or INVALID and the ParameterDefinition contains a conversion, then the convertedValue of the ParameterValue shall contain the converted value. It is supported that other, implementation specific, mechanisms may be used to determine parameter validity. It is supported that other, deployment specific, validityState values be used however the meaning of those values is deployment specific and outside the scope of this standard. They must use values greater than 127.
The definitions of the parameters shall be represented as ParameterDefinition COM objects.
Parameter value reports shall be represented as ParameterValue COM objects.
The ParameterValue object shall use the related link to indicate which ParameterDefinition object it uses.

The source link of the ParameterDefinition object should be the object that caused it to be created, most likely a COM OperationActivity object or an operator login in the case of off-line editors being used.
The source link of the ParameterValue object should be the object that caused the report to be generated.
The source link of the ParameterValue object shall be NULL for periodic reports.
ParameterDefinition objects should be stored in the COM archive.
When a parameter value report is published, the ParameterValue object should be stored in the COM archive.

mal:pubsubIP.name: monitorValue
mal:pubsubIP.comment: The monitorValue operation allows a consumer to subscribe for parameter value reports.
mal:pubsubIP.mal:documentation: The timestamp of the ParameterValue report shall be taken from the publish message and shall be the time of the parameter value update.
If no source link is needed then the ObjectId shall be replaced with a NULL.

mal:field.name: name
mal:field.comment: The name of the parameter.

mal:field.name: parameterId
mal:field.comment: The id of the ParameterDefinition object.

mal:field.name: parameterValueId
mal:field.comment: The id of the ParameterValue object.

mal:field.name: objId
mal:field.comment: The ObjectId of the source link of the report.

mal:field.name: newValue
mal:field.comment: The ParameterValue object value.

mal:requestIP.name: getValue
mal:requestIP.comment: The getValue operation returns the latest received value for a requested parameter.
mal:requestIP.mal:documentation: The wildcard value of '0' shall be supported and matches all parameters of the provider.
The wildcard value should be checked for first, if found no other checks of supplied ids shall be made.
If a requested parameter is unknown then an UNKNOWN error shall be returned.
If a parameter is being reported periodically, using the operation shall not reset the reportInterval timer.
The new value shall not be published via the monitorValue operation.

mal:field.name: paramInstIds
mal:field.comment: The list of ParameterDefinition ids.

mal:field.name: paramValDetails
mal:field.comment: The list of returned ParameterDefinition ids and matching parameter values.

mal:errorRef.comment: One or more of the requested parameters is unknown.

mal:extraInformation.comment: A list of the indexes of the error values shall be contained in the extra information field.

mal:submitIP.name: setValue
mal:submitIP.comment: The setValue operation allows a consumer to set the raw value for one or more parameters.
mal:submitIP.mal:documentation: If the paramInstId field contains the wildcard value of '0' then an INVALID error shall be returned.
If a requested ParameterDefinition is unknown then an UNKNOWN error shall be returned.
If a request ParameterDefinition is not settable due to it being read only then a READONLY error shall be returned.
The rawValue shall contain the new parameter raw value to be set.
If the supplied new parameter raw value does not match the defined type for the ParameterDefinition then an INVALID error shall be returned.
If an error is raised then no modifications shall be made as a result of this operation call.

The parameter values shall be set concurrently, by this it is meant that all values are set at the same time without interleaving of other values being (ATOMIC behaviour). How this is implemented is an implementation detail.
The service provider shall create new ParameterValue objects for the updated parameter values, store these in the COM Archive, and publish these new values.

mal:field.name: newRawValues
mal:field.comment: The list of ParameterRawValues containing the ParameterDefinition id and the respective raw value to be set.

mal:errorRef.comment: One or more of the referenced parameters is unknown.

mal:extraInformation.comment: A list of the indexes of the error values shall be contained in the extra information field.

mal:errorRef.comment: One or more of the parameters being set is read only.

mal:extraInformation.comment: A list of the indexes of the error values shall be contained in the extra information field.

mal:errorRef.comment: One of the supplied parameter values contains an invalid value.

mal:extraInformation.comment: The extra information field contains a list of the indexes of the erroneous values from the originating list supplied.

mal:requestIP.name: enableGeneration
mal:requestIP.comment: The enableGeneration operation allows a consumer to control whether reports for specific parameters are generated or not.
mal:requestIP.mal:documentation: The enableInstances field shall contain the ParameterDefinition ids to match.
The id of the enableInstances field shall support the wildcard value of '0' and matches all ParameterDefinition objects of the provider.
The service provider shall check for the wildcard value in the list of ids in the enableInstances field first and if found no other checks of supplied ids shall be made.
If the enableInstances field contains a value of TRUE then reports for matching ParameterDefinition objects shall be generated, a value of FALSE requests that reports will not be generated.

No error shall be raised if the enableInstances Boolean value supplied is the same as the current generationEnabled field of the definition for a matched ParameterDefinition object i.e. enabling an already enabled parameter will not result in an error.
If a requested ParameterDefinition object is unknown then an UNKNOWN error shall be returned.
If an error is raised then no modifications shall be made as a result of this operation call.
The provider shall create and store a new ParameterDefinition object in the COM archive if the generationEnabled field is changed.
If a new ParameterDefinition object is created then that new object shall be the current ParameterDefinition used for the parameter.
If the generation of reports is being enabled, and the parameter is defined as being periodic, then the provider shall generate a report immediately and start the report interval from that report.

mal:field.name: enableInstances
mal:field.comment: The list of ParameterDefinition ids and their enable/disable flag.

mal:field.name: newObjInstIds
mal:field.comment: The list of ids for the new ParameterDefinition objects.

mal:errorRef.comment: One or more of the requested parameters is unknown.

mal:extraInformation.comment: A list of the indexes of the error values shall be contained in the extra information field.

mal:requestIP.name: listDefinition
mal:requestIP.comment: The listDefinition operation allows a consumer to request the ids of the ParameterDefinition objects for the supported parameters of the provider.
mal:requestIP.mal:documentation: The paramNames field may contain the wildcard value of '*' to return all supported ParameterDefinition objects.
The wildcard value should be checked for first, if found no other checks of supplied identifiers shall be made.
If a provided identifier does not include a wildcard and does not match an existing ParameterDefinition object then this operation shall fail with an UNKNOWN error.
The returned list shall maintain the same order as the submitted list unless the wildcard value was included in the request.

mal:field.name: paramNames
mal:field.comment: The list of parameter names to retrieve the ParameterDefinition ids for.

mal:field.name: ids
mal:field.comment: The list of ids matching the ParameterDefinitions.

mal:errorRef.comment: One of the supplied identifiers is unknown.

mal:extraInformation.comment: A list of the indexes of the error values shall be contained in the extra information field.

mal:requestIP.name: updateDefinition
mal:requestIP.comment: The updateDefinition operation allows a consumer to update a definition for one or more parameters. The replacement definition should be stored in the COM archive by the service provider. The operation does not remove the previous object from the COM archive, merely removes the object from the provider.
mal:requestIP.mal:documentation: The supplied ids shall match existing ParameterDefinition objects, an UNKNOWN error shall be raised if this is not the case.
If the paramInstIds list contains either NULL or '0' an INVALID error shall be raised.
The two lists shall be ordered the same and shall be the same size, otherwise an INVALID error shall be returned.
If the supplied reportInterval value is not supported by the provider then an INVALID error shall be returned.
If an error is raised then no definitions shall be updated as a result of this operation call.
The provider shall create a new ParameterDefinition object and store it in the COM archive.
The new ParameterDefinition object shall be the current ParameterDefinition used for the parameter.
The returned list shall maintain the same order as the submitted definitions.

mal:field.name: paramInstIds
mal:field.comment: The ids of the ParameterDefinition objects to be updated.

mal:field.name: definitions
mal:field.comment: The updated ParameterDefinition objects.

mal:field.name: newObjInstIds
mal:field.comment: The list of ids for the new ParameterDefinition objects.

mal:errorRef.comment: The supplied ids list contains either a NULL or '0' or the two supplied lists are not the same length or a supplied interval is not supported by the provider. If the two lists are not the same length then the extra information field shall contain the first index of the element in the largest list which does not have corresponding element in the other list.

mal:extraInformation.comment: The extra information field contains a list of the indexes of the erroneous values from the originating list supplied.

mal:errorRef.comment: One of the supplied ParameterDefinition ids is unknown.

mal:extraInformation.comment: A list of the indexes of the error values shall be contained in the extra information field.

com:objects.comment: Parameter definitions and value instances are represented as COM objects.

com:sourceObject.comment: The object that caused it to be created, for example, a COM OperationActivity
The object that caused the value to be generated or NULL for periodic reports

com:archiveUsage.comment: Parameter objects and value instance objects are stored in the COM archive.

mal:service.name: Alert
mal:service.comment: The alert service defines the structures and patterns for the publishing and monitoring of alerts. The alert service uses COM event service to monitor and publish alert events. The generation of alerts can be controlled using the enableGeneration operation. Alert definitions are maintained using the operations defined in this service but storage of definitions is delegated to the COM archive.
mal:service.mal:documentation:
The alert service shall provide:
  1. the capability for reporting of alerts;
  2. the capability for controlling reporting of alerts;
  3. the capability for maintaining the list of alert definitions.
The alert reporting service shall provide the capability to enable and disable the generation of alert reports. It shall be possible to update, delete, and add alert definitions. The list of the alert definitions may be requested.

The generation of alerts shall be controlled by the generationEnabled Boolean value in the AlertDefinition. Setting the generationEnabled field to TRUE shall enable generation of instances of that alert. The generationEnabled value can be set by using either the enableGeneration or updateDefinition operations. The alert instances shall be published as events using the COM event operations.
The definitions of the alerts shall be represented as AlertDefinition COM objects.
Instances of an alert shall be represented as an AlertEvent COM event.
The AlertEvent object shall use the related link to indicate which AlertDefinition object it uses.

The source link of the AlertDefinition object should be the object that caused it to be created, most likely a COM OperationActivity object or an operator login in the case of off-line editors being used.
When an alert is generated it shall be represented as a COM event.
The event shall be published using the COM event service.
The source link of the AlertEvent object shall be the object that caused the event to be generated.
AlertDefinition objects should be stored in the COM archive.
When an alert event is published, the AlertEvent object should be stored in the COM archive by the publisher.

mal:requestIP.name: enableGeneration
mal:requestIP.comment: The enableGeneration operation allows a consumer to control whether updates for specific alerts are generated or not.
mal:requestIP.mal:documentation: The enableInstances field shall contain the AlertDefinition ids to match.
The id of the enableInstances field shall support the wildcard value of '0' and matches all AlertDefinition objects of the provider.
The service provider shall check for the wildcard value in the list of ids in the enableInstances field first and if found no other checks of supplied ids shall be made.
If the enableInstances field contains a value of TRUE then instances of matching AlertDefinition objects shall be generated, a value of FALSE requests that instances will not be generated.

No error shall be raised if the enableInstances Boolean value supplied is the same as the current generationEnabled field for an alert object i.e. enabling an already enabled alert will not result in an error.
If a requested AlertDefinition object is unknown then an UNKNOWN error shall be returned.
If an error is raised then no modifications shall be made as a result of this operation call.
The provider shall create and store a new AlertDefinition object in the COM archive if the generationEnabled field is changed.
If a new AlertDefinition object is created then that new object shall be the current AlertDefinition used for the alert.

mal:field.name: enableInstances
mal:field.comment: The list of AlertDefinition ids and their enable/disable flag.

mal:field.name: newObjInstIds
mal:field.comment: The list of ids for the new AlertDefinition objects.

mal:errorRef.comment: One or more of the requested alerts is unknown.

mal:extraInformation.comment: A list of the indexes of the error values shall be contained in the extra information field.

mal:requestIP.name: listDefinition
mal:requestIP.comment: The listDefinition operation allows a consumer to request the ids of the AlertDefinition objects for the supported alerts of the provider.
mal:requestIP.mal:documentation: The alertNames field may contain the wildcard value of '*' to return all supported AlertDefinition objects.
The wildcard value should be checked for first, if found no other checks of supplied identifiers shall be made.
If a provided identifier does not include a wildcard and does not match an existing AlertDefinition object then this operation shall fail with an UNKNOWN error.
The returned list shall maintain the same order as the submitted list unless the wildcard value was included in the request.

mal:field.name: alertNames
mal:field.comment: The list of alert names to retrieve the AlertDefinition ids for.

mal:field.name: ids
mal:field.comment: The list of ids matching the AlertDefinitions.

mal:errorRef.comment: One of the supplied identifiers is unknown.

mal:extraInformation.comment: A list of the indexes of the error values shall be contained in the extra information field.

mal:requestIP.name: updateDefinition
mal:requestIP.comment: The updateDefinition operation allows a consumer to update a definition for one or more alerts. The replacement definition should be stored in the COM archive by the service provider. The operation does not remove the previous object from the COM archive, merely removes the object from the provider.
mal:requestIP.mal:documentation: The supplied ids shall match existing AlertDefinition objects, an UNKNOWN error shall be raised if this is not the case.
If the alertObjInstIds list contains either NULL or '0' an INVALID error shall be raised.
The two lists shall be ordered the same and shall be the same size, otherwise an INVALID error shall be returned.
If an error is raised then no definitions shall be updated as a result of this operation call.
The provider shall create a new AlertDefinition object and store it in the COM archive.
The new AlertDefinition object shall be the current AlertDefinition used for the alert.
The returned list shall maintain the same order as the submitted definitions.

If the two lists are not the same length then the extra information field shall contain the first index of the element in the largest list which does not have corresponding element in the other list.

mal:extraInformation.comment: The extra information field contains a list of the indexes of the erroneous values from the originating list supplied.

mal:extraInformation.comment: A list of the indexes of the error values shall be contained in the extra information field.

mal:service.name: Aggregation
mal:service.comment:
The aggregation service allows the user to acquire several parameter values in a single request. Aggregations are generated either periodically, on an ad-hoc basis, or after a configurable timeout when being filtered. Periodic is where they are generated at a specific generation interval; in this case the periodicity is an aspect of the aggregation rather than the contained parameters. Ad-hoc is when the aggregation generation is triggered by some other deployment-specific mechanism. Filtering is where an aggregation is only generated when the change in the value of the filtered parameters exceeds a specified threshold or a timeout is passed. Filtering can be applied to both periodic and ad-hoc aggregations. As there may be a large amount of time between reports of an aggregation when filtering is applied, the filtering concept also has a maximum reporting interval. If a report of the aggregation has not passed the filter in the maximum reporting interval a report is generated regardless. This allows there to be regular reports of an aggregation sent regardless of filtering. It should be noted that applying a filter with a maximum reporting interval to an ad-hoc aggregation will cause the aggregation to generate reports in a periodic way if the maximum reporting interval is left to expire. This is expected behaviour. There are a number of intervals defined in the structures of the service, the diagram in Figure 3-12 illustrates the use of these: insert timing diagram The diagram shows a single report of an aggregation being generated which contains two parameter sets. Each set of parameter values in the aggregation report contains two optional durations, delta time and interval time.
  • The timestamp of the first value of the first set (T1) is defined as the timestamp of the aggregation report plus the delta time of the first set.
  • The timestamp of the second value of the first set (T2) is defined as the timestamp of the first parameter (T1) plus the interval time of the set.
  • The timestamp of the first value of the second set (T3) is defined as the timestamp of the last value of the previous set (T2) plus the delta time of the second set.
  • The timestamp of the second value of the second set (T4) is defined as the timestamp of the first parameter (T3) plus the interval time of the set.
The COM archive is used to hold the definitions of the aggregations.
mal:service.mal:documentation:
The aggregation service shall provide:
  1. the capability for periodic reporting of predefined aggregation values;
  2. the capability for requesting the current value of a set of aggregations;
  3. the capability for controlling reporting of the aggregation values;
  4. the capability for maintaining the list of aggregation definitions.
Three modes of generating an aggregation value shall exist: periodic, ad-hoc, and filtered:
  1. Periodic reports for aggregations shall be generated once for each cycle of a specified interval.
  2. Ad-hoc reports for aggregations shall be triggered by some other deployment-specific means.
  3. Filtered reports for aggregations shall be generated only when the value of one or more parameters in the aggregation has changed by more than a given threshold since the previous generation or when a timeout expires.

The generation of reports for an aggregation shall be controlled by the generationEnabled Boolean value in the AggregationDefinition structure. Setting the generationEnabled field to TRUE shall enable generation of reports for a specific aggregation. The generationEnabled values can be set by using the enableGeneration operation. The filtering of reports for an aggregation shall be controlled by the filterEnabled Boolean value in the AggregationDefinition structure. Setting the filterEnabled field to TRUE shall enable filtering of reports for a specific aggregation. The filterEnabled values can be set by using the enableFilter operation. If an aggregation is required to send periodic reports, then the time between these reports shall be controlled using the reportInterval Duration value in the AggregationDefinition structure. Periodic reports for aggregations shall set the generationMode field of the AggregationValueInstance to PERIODIC. No periodic reports shall be generated when the reportInterval field is set to '0' and reports will be triggered by another ad-hoc implementation-specific mechanism in this case. Ad-hoc reports for aggregations shall set the generationMode field of the AggregationValueInstance to ADHOC. If an aggregation is filtered, reports shall be generated only when the value of one or more parameters in the aggregation have changed by more than a given threshold since the previous generated aggregation report. The threshold for the filter shall be defined, on a per-parameter basis, either as a percentage or an (absolute) delta change in value. Parameters in an aggregation that do not have a filter specified in the aggregation definition shall be ignored by the filter comparison process. If filtering is enabled and a filtered timeout has been set for that aggregation, if no change has been detected in that time-out period, an aggregation value shall be generated with a generation mode of FILTERED_TIMEOUT. This measure ensures that extensive periods of time do not elapse without reports of an enabled aggregation. The generationEnabled, filterEnabled, filteredTimeout, sendUnchanged and reportInterval values of an AggregationDefinition object can be set by using the updateDefinition operation. If the filteredTimeout interval, reportInterval or one or more of the sampleIntervals requested are not supported by the provider then an INVALID error shall be returned and the creation or change rejected. If the sendUnchanged field in the AggregationDefinition object is FALSE then parameter values that have not changed since the previous report shall be replaced by a NULL in the values list of the AggregationSetValue composite. The ordering of the values in the AggregationValueInstance object shall match the ordering of parameters in the AggregationDefinition structure.
The definitions of the aggregations shall be represented as AggregationDefinition COM objects.
Aggregation value reports shall be represented as AggregationValueInstance COM objects.
The AggregationValueInstance object shall use the related link to indicate which AggregationDefinition object it uses.

The source link of the AggregationDefinition object should be the object that caused it to be created, most likely a COM OperationActivity object or an operator login in the case of off-line editors being used.
The source link of the AggregationValueInstance object should be the object that caused the report to be generated.
The source link of the AggregationValueInstance object shall be NULL for periodic reports.
AggregationDefinition objects should be stored in the COM archive.
When an aggregation value report is published, the AggregationValueInstance object should be stored in the COM archive.

mal:pubsubIP.name: monitorValue
mal:pubsubIP.comment: The monitorValue operation allows a consumer to subscribe for aggregation value reports.
mal:pubsubIP.mal:documentation: The timestamp of the AggregationValueInstance report shall be taken from the publish message.
If no source link is needed then the ObjectId shall be replaced with a NULL.

mal:field.name: aggregationName
mal:field.comment: The name of the aggregation.

mal:field.name: definitionId
mal:field.comment: The id of the AggregationDefinition object.

mal:field.name: aValObjId
mal:field.comment: The id of the AggregationValueInstance object.

mal:field.name: objId
mal:field.comment: The ObjectId of the source link of the report.

mal:field.name: newValue
mal:field.comment: The AggregationValue.

mal:requestIP.name: getValue
mal:requestIP.comment: The getValue operation returns the latest received value for a requested aggregation.
mal:requestIP.mal:documentation: The wildcard value of '0' shall be supported and matches all aggregations of the provider.
The wildcard value should be checked for first, if found no other checks of supplied ids shall be made.
If a requested aggregation is unknown then an UNKNOWN error shall be returned.
The filter shall not be applied for the getValue operation.
If an aggregation is being reported periodically, using the operation shall not reset the reportInterval or filteredTimeout timer.
The new value shall not be published via the monitorValue operation.

mal:field.name: aggInstIds
mal:field.comment: The list of AggregationDefinition ids.

mal:field.name: aggValDetails
mal:field.comment: The list of returned AggregationDefinition ids and matching AggregationValues.

mal:errorRef.comment: One or more of the requested aggregations is unknown.

mal:extraInformation.comment: A list of the indexes of the error values shall be contained in the extra information field.

mal:requestIP.name: enableGeneration
mal:requestIP.comment: The enableGeneration operation allows a consumer to control whether reports for specific aggregations are generated or not. This affects all types of aggregations, periodic, filtered and ad-hoc.
mal:requestIP.mal:documentation: The enableInstances field shall contain the AggregationDefinition ids to match.
The id of the enableInstances field shall support the wildcard value of '0' and matches all AggregationDefinition objects of the provider.
The service provider shall check for the wildcard value in the list of ids in the enableInstances field first and if found no other checks of supplied ids shall be made.
If the enableInstances field contains a value of TRUE then reports of matching AggregationDefinition objects shall be generated, a value of FALSE requests that reports will not be generated.

No error shall be raised if the enableInstances Boolean value supplied is the same as the current generationEnabled field of the definition for a matched AggregationDefinition object i.e. enabling an already enabled aggregation will not result in an error.
If a requested AggregationDefinition object is unknown then an UNKNOWN error shall be returned.
If an error is raised then no modifications shall be made as a result of this operation call.
The provider shall create and store a new AggregationDefinition object in the COM archive if the generationEnabled field is changed.
If a new AggregationDefinition object is created then that new object shall be the current AggregationDefinition used for the aggregation.
If the generation of reports is being enabled, and the aggregation is defined as being periodic, then the provider shall generate a report immediately and start the report interval from that report.

mal:field.name: enableInstances
mal:field.comment: The list of AggregationDefinition ids and their desired generation state.

mal:field.name: newObjInstIds
mal:field.comment: The list of ids for the new AggregationDefinition objects.

mal:errorRef.comment: One or more of the requested aggregations is unknown.

mal:extraInformation.comment: A list of the indexes of the error values shall be contained in the extra information field.

mal:submitIP.name: enableFilter
mal:submitIP.comment: The enableFilter operation allows a consumer to control whether reports for specific aggregations are filtered or not. This affects both periodic and ad-hoc aggregations.
mal:submitIP.mal:documentation: The enableInstances field shall contain the AggregationDefinition ids to match.
The id of the enableInstances field shall support the wildcard value of '0' and matches all AggregationDefinition objects of the provider.
The service provider shall check for the wildcard value in the list of ids in the enableInstances field first and if found no other checks of supplied ids shall be made.
If the enableInstances field contains a value of TRUE then reports of matching AggregationDefinition objects shall be filtered, a value of FALSE requests that reports will not be filtered.

No error shall be raised if the enableInstances Boolean value supplied is the same as the current filterEnabled field of the definition for a matched AggregationDefinition object i.e. filtering an already filtered aggregation will not result in an error.
If a requested AggregationDefinition object is unknown then an UNKNOWN error shall be returned.
If an error is raised then no modifications shall be made as a result of this operation call.
The provider shall create and store a new AggregationDefinition object in the COM archive if the filterEnabled field is changed.
If a new AggregationDefinition object is created then that new object shall be the current AggregationDefinition used for the aggregation.

mal:field.name: enableInstances
mal:field.comment: The list of AggregationDefinition ids and their enable/disable flag.

mal:errorRef.comment: One or more of the requested aggregations is unknown.

mal:extraInformation.comment: A list of the indexes of the error values shall be contained in the extra information field.

mal:requestIP.name: listDefinition
mal:requestIP.comment: The listDefinition operation allows a consumer to request the ids of the AggregationDefinition objects for the supported aggregations of the provider.
mal:requestIP.mal:documentation: The aggNames field may contain the wildcard value of '*' to return all supported AggregationDefinition objects.
The wildcard value should be checked for first, if found no other checks of supplied identifiers shall be made.
If a provided identifier does not include a wildcard and does not match an existing AggregationDefinition object then this operation shall fail with an UNKNOWN error.
The returned list shall maintain the same order as the submitted list unless the wildcard value was included in the request.

mal:field.name: aggregationNames
mal:field.comment: The list of aggregation names to retrieve the AggregationDefinition ids for.

mal:field.name: ids
mal:field.comment: The list of ids matching the AggregationDefinitions.

mal:errorRef.comment: One of the supplied identifiers is unknown.

mal:extraInformation.comment: A list of the indexes of the error values shall be contained in the extra information field.

mal:requestIP.name: addAggregation
mal:requestIP.comment: The addAggregation operation allows a consumer to define one or more aggregations that do not currently exist. The new AggregationDefinition objects are expected to be stored in the COM archive by the provider of the aggregation service.
mal:requestIP.mal:documentation: The name field must not be the wildcard '*', or empty (an INVALID error shall be returned in this case).
If the supplied reportInterval or sampleInterval values are not supported by the provider then an INVALID error shall be returned.
The supplied name must be unique among all AggregationDefinition objects for the domain of the provider otherwise a DUPLICATE error shall be raised.
If an error is raised then no new definitions shall be added as a result of this operation call.
The provider shall create a new AggregationDefinition object and store it in the COM archive.
The returned list shall maintain the same order as the submitted definitions.

mal:field.name: aggDefDetails
mal:field.comment: The name and the AggregationDefinition to be added.

mal:field.name: newIds
mal:field.comment: The list of ids for the new AggregationDefinition objects.

mal:errorRef.comment: One or more of the aggregation objects being added has supplied an aggregation name that is already in use in the domain.

mal:extraInformation.comment: The extra information field contains a list of the indexes of the erroneous values from the originating request list.

mal:errorRef.comment: One of the supplied aggregation objects contains an invalid name or a supplied interval is not supported by the provider.

mal:extraInformation.comment: The extra information field contains a list of the indexes of the erroneous values from the originating list supplied.

mal:requestIP.name: updateDefinition
mal:requestIP.comment: The updateDefinition operation allows a consumer to update a definition for one or more aggregations. The replacement definition should be stored in the COM archive by the service provider. The operation does not remove the previous object from the COM archive, merely removes the object from the provider.
mal:requestIP.mal:documentation: The supplied ids shall match existing AggregationDefinition objects, an UNKNOWN error shall be raised if this is not the case.
If the aggInstIds list contains either NULL or '0' an INVALID error shall be raised.
The two lists shall be ordered the same and shall be the same size, otherwise an INVALID error shall be returned.
If the supplied reportInterval or sampleInterval values are not supported by the provider then an INVALID error shall be returned.
If an error is raised then no definitions shall be updated as a result of this operation call.
The provider shall create a new AggregationDefinition object and store it in the COM archive.
The new AggregationDefinition object shall be the current AggregationDefinition used for the aggregation.
The returned list shall maintain the same order as the submitted definitions.

mal:field.name: aggInstIds
mal:field.comment: The ids of the AggregationDefinition objects to be updated.

mal:field.name: aggDefDetails
mal:field.comment: The replacement AggregationDefinition objects.

mal:field.name: newObjInstIds
mal:field.comment: The list of ids for the new AggregationDefinition objects.

mal:errorRef.comment: One of the supplied AggregationDefinition ids is unknown.

mal:extraInformation.comment: A list of the indexes of the error values shall be contained in the extra information field.

mal:errorRef.comment: The supplied ids list contains either a NULL or '0' or the two supplied lists are not the same length or a supplied interval is not supported by the provider. If the two lists are not the same length then the extra information field shall contain the first index of the element in the largest list which does not have corresponding element in the other list.

mal:extraInformation.comment: The extra information field contains a list of the indexes of the erroneous values from the originating list supplied.

mal:submitIP.name: removeAggregation
mal:submitIP.comment: The removeAggregation operation allows a consumer to remove one or more aggregations from the list of aggregations supported by the aggregation provider. The operation does not remove the AggregationDefinition objects from the COM archive, merely removes the objects from the provider. This permits existing AggregationValueInstance objects to continue to reference the correct AggregationDefinition object in the COM archive.
mal:submitIP.mal:documentation: The list may contain the wildcard value of '0'.
The wildcard value should be checked for first, if found no other checks of supplied ids shall be made.
If a provided AggregationDefinition id does not include a wildcard and does not match an existing aggregation then this operation shall fail with an UNKNOWN error.
Matched AggregationDefinition objects shall not be removed from the COM archive, only the list of AggregationDefinition objects in the provider.
If an error is raised then no aggregations shall be removed as a result of this operation call.
If the operation succeeds then the provider shall not publish aggregation values for the deleted AggregationDefinition objects anymore.

mal:field.name: aggInstIds
mal:field.comment: The ids of the AggregationDefinition objects to be removed.

mal:errorRef.comment: One of the supplied AggregationDefinition ids is unknown.

mal:extraInformation.comment: A list of the indexes of the error values shall be contained in the extra information field.

com:objects.comment: Aggregation definitions and value instances are represented as COM objects.

com:sourceObject.comment: The object that caused it to be created, for example, a COM OperationActivity
The object that caused the value to be generated or NULL for periodic reports

com:archiveUsage.comment: Aggregation definition and value instance objects are stored in the COM archive.

mal:service.name: Conversion
mal:service.comment: The conversion service provides a set of basic conversion definition types that allows the specification of a conversion between two representations. These conversions are used by the other MC services (such as Action, Alert, and Parameter) to define conversions from raw field representations to some engineering representation. Conversions are associated with other entities such as parameters or action/alert arguments through the configuration of the relevant service (action/alert/parameter). The conversion service does not provide any operations directly, but allows consumers to add, remove, and modify conversion definitions via the COM archive.
mal:service.mal:documentation: The conversion service shall provide the capability for maintaining the list of conversion definitions.

The conversion service shall use the COM archive operations for maintaining the conversion definitions. Updating a conversion definition shall be performed by adding a new conversion definition and referencing it in the service specific COM objects (such as ParameterDefinition). A Discrete conversion must contain at least one pair of values in the mapping. A Line conversion must contain at least two line points. A Polynomial conversion must contain at least one pair of values in the points list. A Range conversion must contain at least one pair of values in the points list. The service that references a conversion should ensure that the conversion referenced is correct.
The definitions of the conversions shall be represented as either DiscreteConversion, LineConversion, PolyConversion, or RangeConversion COM objects.

The source link of the conversion definition object should be the object that caused it to be created, most likely a COM OperationActivity object or an operator login in the case of off-line editors being used.
Other service objects shall reference instances of a conversion using the id of the conversion definition.
Conversion definition objects should be stored in the COM archive.
Each instance of a conversion definition shall be represented by an object instance held in the COM archive.
The COM archive service operations shall be used to add, update and remove conversions.
Other services should monitor the archive service for changes to conversions they reference.

com:objects.comment: Conversion definitions are represented as COM objects.

com:sourceObject.comment: The object that caused it to be created, for example, a COM OperationActivity.
The object that caused it to be created, for example, a COM OperationActivity.
The object that caused it to be created, for example, a COM OperationActivity.
The object that caused it to be created, for example, a COM OperationActivity.

com:archiveUsage.comment: Conversion definition objects are stored in the COM archive.

mal:enumeration.name: Severity
mal:enumeration.comment: The severity enumeration holds the possible values for a severity. The numerical value represents the increasing severity, therefore CRITICAL is more severe than ALARM. Normally, for checks, only the Warning and Critical ranges are used: the colour yellow is associated with Warning, and the colour red is associated with Critical.

mal:item.comment: Indicates a nominal situation with no consequences.
Indicates unexpected behaviour without directly threatening consequences.
Indicates behaviour of serious concern requiring the attention of an operator, but not necessarily a malfunction.
Indicates that the monitored item has malfunctioned. Requires operator attention.
Indicates behaviour with mission threatening consequences. Requires operator attention.

mal:composite.name: ArgumentDefinition
mal:composite.comment: The ArgumentDefinition structure holds the details of an argument definition with a set of associated attributes, such as conversion used. The conditionalConversions define the conditions where a referenced conversion is applied. Only the first TRUE conversion should be applied.

mal:field.name: argId
mal:field.comment: The argument definition identifier.

mal:field.name: description
mal:field.comment: An optional argument description.

mal:field.name: rawType
mal:field.comment: The attribute raw type of the argument.

mal:field.name: rawUnit
mal:field.comment: The unit for the raw value.

mal:composite.name: AttributeValue
mal:composite.comment: The AttributeValue structure holds an Attribute value. It allows a list of different Attribute types to be created whereas List of Attribute would require the values to be all of the same type.

mal:field.name: value
mal:field.comment: The argument value. Must not be NULL. NULL may be represented by having a NULL in place of the complete AttributeValue composite.

mal:composite.name: ConditionalConversion
mal:composite.comment: The ConditionalConversion structure holds a condition expression to be evaluated to determine if a specific Conversion should be used. In the case that no test is required, i.e., the conversion should always be used, then the condition field should be set to NULL.

mal:field.name: condition
mal:field.comment: The expression indicates which entities are applicable for this check. If NULL, then the condition shall evaluate to TRUE.

mal:field.name: conversionId
mal:field.comment: The id of the Conversion to be used if the condition evaluates to TRUE or is NULL.

mal:composite.name: ParameterExpression
mal:composite.comment: The ParameterExpression structure represents a simple expression between a parameter and a value for that parameter.

mal:field.name: parameterId
mal:field.comment: Holds the id of the Parameter to be used in the expression.

mal:field.name: operator
mal:field.comment: The expression operator.

mal:field.name: useConverted
mal:field.comment: If set to TRUE the converted value field of the parameter value should be used, otherwise the raw value field should be used.

mal:field.name: value
mal:field.comment: The value to be used in the expression.

mal:enumeration.name: ActionCategory
mal:enumeration.comment: Contains the default Action category values. It is implementation specific what the meaning of the values are in a particular context.

mal:item.comment: Default category
Category for high priority actions
Category for critical actions

mal:enumeration.name: ExecutionStageType
mal:enumeration.comment: Identifies the lifecycle stage of an action execution update published via the monitorExecution operation.

mal:item.comment: Indicates the beginning of action execution.
Indicates an intermediate progress update during action execution.
Indicates the end of action execution, whether successful or not.

mal:composite.name: ActionDefinition
mal:composite.comment: The ActionDefinition structure holds the definition information of an action.

mal:field.name: name
mal:field.comment: The name of the action. Must not be empty or the wildcard value.

mal:field.name: description
mal:field.comment: The description of the action.

mal:field.name: category
mal:field.comment: The category of the action.

mal:field.name: progressStepCount
mal:field.comment: Total number of steps that will be reported if PROGRESS reporting is selected in the sent Action. 0 if PROGRESS reporting is not used.

mal:field.name: arguments
mal:field.comment: The list of argument definitions. If no arguments are defined, then the complete list is replaced with a NULL.

mal:composite.name: ExecutionRequest
mal:composite.comment: The ExecutionRequest structure holds the information required for an execution of an action such as the argument values to use.

mal:field.name: definitionId
mal:field.comment: The id of the ActionDefinition to be used.

mal:field.name: argumentValues
mal:field.comment: List containing the values of the arguments. The ordering of the list matches that of the definition. If a value for a particular entry is not being supplied, then its position is filled with a NULL value. If no arguments are defined, then the complete list is replaced with a NULL.

mal:field.name: argumentIds
mal:field.comment: Optional list of argument definition identifiers. Allows the provider to verify that the correct arguments are being supplied. The ordering of the list matches that of the argument list of the action definition.

mal:composite.name: ExecutionStatus
mal:composite.comment: The ExecutionStatus structure holds the progress status of a single execution stage of an action. An ExecutionStatus object is stored in the COM archive each time a monitorExecution notification is published.

mal:field.name: stageType
mal:field.comment: The lifecycle stage of the execution.

mal:field.name: success
mal:field.comment: Indicates whether the execution stage completed successfully.

mal:field.name: step
mal:field.comment: The progress step number. Null for START and END stages.

mal:field.name: comment
mal:field.comment: An optional comment providing additional details about the execution stage.

mal:enumeration.name: ValidityState
mal:enumeration.comment: Convenience enumeration that holds the validity states and their numeric values.

mal:item.comment: The parameter has a timeout associated which has expired
The parameter raw value cannot be obtained, or calculated for synthetic parameters
The validity expression either has evaluated to TRUE or there is no validity defined, but the conversion of the parameter value has failed (for example an unexpected value for a discrete conversion)
The validity of the validity expression has been evaluated to FALSE and therefore cannot be used to verify the current value
The validity expression has been evaluated to FALSE

mal:composite.name: ParameterDefinition
mal:composite.comment: The ParameterDefinition structure holds a parameter definition. The conversion field defines the conditions where the relevant conversion is applied. For onboard parameters, the report interval should be a multiple of the minimum sampling interval of that parameter.

mal:field.name: name
mal:field.comment: The name of the parameter. Must not be empty or the wildcard value.

mal:field.name: description
mal:field.comment: The description of the parameter. May be empty.

mal:field.name: rawType
mal:field.comment: Holds the attribute short form part of the raw type of the parameter, e.g., for a MAL::String parameter it shall hold 15.

mal:field.name: rawUnit
mal:field.comment: The unit for the raw value. If NULL then raw type has no unit.

mal:field.name: generationEnabled
mal:field.comment: Controls whether reports for this parameter are to be generated.

mal:field.name: reportInterval
mal:field.comment: Periodic report interval. No periodic reports to be generated if this is set to '0'.

mal:field.name: validityExpression
mal:field.comment: Expression that determines this parameter's validity state. Can be NULL if no validity check is required or validity is calculated by implementation-specific mechanisms.

mal:field.name: conversion
mal:field.comment: If present then parameter has a converted type.

mal:composite.name: ParameterValue
mal:composite.comment: This structure holds a specific value of the parameter. The type of the value shall match that specified in the parameter definition.

mal:field.name: validityState
mal:field.comment: Holds the validity state for a parameter value. If the parameter is valid then this should be set to '0'.

mal:field.name: rawValue
mal:field.comment: The parameter raw value. The value of NULL is a valid value and carries no special significance in the parameter service.

mal:field.name: convertedValue
mal:field.comment: The parameter converted value.

mal:composite.name: ParameterConversion
mal:composite.comment: The ParameterConversion structure holds information about the conversions to be applied to a parameter.

mal:field.name: convertedType
mal:field.comment: Holds the attribute short form part of the converted type of the parameter, e.g., for a MAL::String parameter it shall hold 15.

mal:field.name: convertedUnit
mal:field.comment: The converted parameter unit. If NULL then converted type has no unit.

mal:field.name: conditionalConversions
mal:field.comment: The conversions to be applied. Only the first TRUE conversion should be applied.

mal:composite.name: ParameterRawValue
mal:composite.comment: The ParameterRawValue structure holds a new raw value for a specific parameter.

mal:field.name: parameterId
mal:field.comment: The id of the parameter.

mal:field.name: rawValue
mal:field.comment: The parameter raw value. The value of NULL is a valid value and carries no special significance in the parameter service.

mal:composite.name: ParameterValueDetails
mal:composite.comment: This structure holds a specific time stamped value of the parameter. The type of the value shall match that specified in the parameter definition.

mal:field.name: defId
mal:field.comment: The id of the Parameter Definition.

mal:field.name: timestamp
mal:field.comment: The timestamp of the value.

mal:field.name: value
mal:field.comment: The parameter value.

mal:composite.name: AlertDefinition
mal:composite.comment: The AlertDefinition provides the definition of an alert including any argument definitions.

mal:field.name: name
mal:field.comment: Alert name. Must not be empty or wildcard value.

mal:field.name: description
mal:field.comment: The description of the alert.

mal:field.name: severity
mal:field.comment: Severity of the alert.

mal:field.name: generationEnabled
mal:field.comment: Controls whether instances of this alert are to be generated.

mal:field.name: arguments
mal:field.comment: The list of argument definitions.

mal:composite.name: AlertEvent
mal:composite.comment: The AlertEvent structure holds the details of an instance of an alert.

mal:field.name: argumentValues
mal:field.comment: List containing the values of the arguments. The ordering of the list matches that of the definition. If a value for a particular entry is not being supplied, then its position is filled with a NULL value. If no arguments are defined, then the complete list is replaced with a NULL.

mal:field.name: argumentIds
mal:field.comment: Optional list of argument definition identifiers. Allows the consumer to verify that the correct arguments are being supplied. The ordering of the list matches that of the argument list of the alert definition.

mal:enumeration.name: AggregationCategory
mal:enumeration.comment: AggregationCategory is an enumeration definition holding the categories of aggregations.

mal:item.comment: General aggregation.
Diagnostic aggregation.

mal:enumeration.name: ThresholdType
mal:enumeration.comment: ThresholdType is an enumeration definition holding the types of filtering thresholds.

mal:item.comment: Threshold value is a percentage.
Threshold value is a delta.

mal:enumeration.name: GenerationMode
mal:enumeration.comment: GenerationMode is an enumeration definition holding the reasons for the aggregation to be generated.

mal:item.comment: The aggregation value was generated because of an ad-hoc implementation dependent reason.
The aggregation value was generated because of a periodic report.
The item is filtered but it exceeded its timeout value.

mal:composite.name: AggregationDefinition
mal:composite.comment: The AggregationDefinition structure holds definition details of an aggregation.

mal:field.name: name
mal:field.comment: The name of the aggregation. Must not be empty or the wildcard value.

mal:field.name: description
mal:field.comment: The description of the parameter. May be empty.

mal:field.name: category
mal:field.comment: The category of the aggregation.

mal:field.name: reportInterval
mal:field.comment: The interval between periodic reports on this aggregation. If this aggregation is not periodic, this field must be '0'.

mal:field.name: sendUnchanged
mal:field.comment: If TRUE reports will include all values regardless of whether changed, if FALSE values unchanged from previous report are replaced with a NULL.

mal:field.name: sendDefinitions
mal:field.comment: If TRUE reports will include the ParameterDefinition id in the AggregationParameterValue, if FALSE it will be set to NULL.

mal:field.name: filterEnabled
mal:field.comment: Controls whether reports for this aggregation are to be filtered.

mal:field.name: filteredTimeout
mal:field.comment: The maximum duration between filtered reports. If this value is exceeded, then a report is sent regardless of filtered thresholds. Ignored if not filtered.

mal:field.name: generationEnabled
mal:field.comment: Controls whether reports for this aggregation are to be generated.

mal:field.name: parameterSets
mal:field.comment: List containing the parameter sets which define the aggregation.

mal:composite.name: AggregationParameterSet
mal:composite.comment: The AggregationParameterSet structure holds the identifier and optional filter for a parameter, or set of parameters, in an aggregation.

mal:field.name: domain
mal:field.comment: The domain of the parameters being referenced in this set of parameters, NULL if the same domain as the aggregation.

mal:field.name: parameters
mal:field.comment: The list of ids of the ParameterDefinition objects being included in the aggregation.

mal:field.name: sampleInterval
mal:field.comment: The interval between samples of the parameters in the set. If '0' then just a single sample of the parameters is required per aggregation report.

mal:field.name: reportFilter
mal:field.comment: If the AggregationParameterSet contains a single parameter then this field contains the filter to apply for filtered reports when filters are applied. NULL if no filter required or this set contains more than one parameter.

mal:composite.name: AggregationValue
mal:composite.comment: The AggregationValue structure holds the values for one or more sets of parameter values. The value sets must be held in the same order as that defined in the matching AggregationDefinition.

mal:field.name: generationMode
mal:field.comment: Reason for the aggregation being generated.

mal:field.name: filtered
mal:field.comment: If a filter is enabled when the aggregation value is generated then this value shall be set to TRUE, else FALSE.

mal:field.name: parameterSetValues
mal:field.comment: The parameterSetValues list holds the sets of values of the aggregation. The sets must be held in the same order as that defined in the aggregation definition.

mal:composite.name: AggregationSetValue
mal:composite.comment: The AggregationSetValue structure holds the values for one set of parameter values. If the definition sendUnchanged field is set to FALSE parameter values that are unchanged since the previous report are replaced by a NULL in this list. The parameter values must be held in the same order as that defined in the matching AggregationDefinition.

mal:field.name: deltaTime
mal:field.comment: Optional delta time, from the timestamp of the aggregation for the first parameter set of the aggregation or the last value of the previous parameter set otherwise, for the first parameter sample of this set. If NULL, then the first sample time is the same as the aggregation timestamp for the first parameter set of the aggregation or the last value of the previous parameter set otherwise.

mal:field.name: intervalTime
mal:field.comment: Optional delta time between samples in this set. If NULL, then all samples in this set are given the same time. This is usually driven by the sampleInterval in the aggregation set definition.

mal:field.name: values
mal:field.comment: List containing values of the parameters which are part of the aggregation. The ordering of the list entries shall match that of the definition of the aggregation. If there are more values than contained in the definition then it is assumed that the parameters cycle as a complete parameter set.

mal:composite.name: AggregationParameterValue
mal:composite.comment: The structure holds a single parameter value with its definition instance identifier.

mal:field.name: value
mal:field.comment: The parameter value.

mal:field.name: paramDefInstId
mal:field.comment: The id of the ParameterDefinition. NULL if sendDefinitions in the AggregationDefinition is FALSE.

mal:composite.name: ThresholdFilter
mal:composite.comment: The ThresholdFilter structure holds the filter for a parameter.

mal:field.name: thresholdType
mal:field.comment: The type of filter to apply for filtered periodic reports when filters are applied.

mal:field.name: thresholdValue
mal:field.comment: Threshold value to apply.

mal:field.name: useConverted
mal:field.comment: If true, and the relevant Parameter has a conversion, then use the converted value for the threshold comparison, otherwise use the raw value.

mal:composite.name: AggregationValueDetails
mal:composite.comment: This structure holds a specific time stamped value of the aggregation.

mal:field.name: defId
mal:field.comment: The AggregationDefinition id.

mal:field.name: timestamp
mal:field.comment: The timestamp of the value. Use for the calculation of the individual parameter value timestamps.

mal:field.name: value
mal:field.comment: The aggregation value.

mal:composite.name: DiscreteConversion
mal:composite.comment: The DiscreteConversion structure holds a bidirectional conversion between raw and converted values. The first element of the pair is the raw value and the second is the converted value. Both sets of values must be unique.

mal:field.name: mapping
mal:field.comment: Defines a mapping between raw and converted values as a discrete set of points. The first entry in the pair is the raw value, and the second entry is the converted value.

mal:composite.name: LineConversion
mal:composite.comment: The LineConversion structure is a bi-directional conversion between raw and converted values. It is defined by a series of points between which values are to be interpolated. The extrapolate attribute indicates if values can also be linearly extrapolated beyond the initial and final points.

mal:field.name: extrapolate
mal:field.comment: Indicates whether or not values can be extrapolated beyond the start and the end of the points.

mal:field.name: points
mal:field.comment: Defines the bi-directional conversion. The first attribute of the point is a raw value, and the second attribute is the converted value.

mal:composite.name: PolyConversion
mal:composite.comment: The PolyConversion structure holds only forward (raw to converted) polynomial conversions. They are defined by a series of points for the polynomial coefficients.

mal:field.name: points
mal:field.comment: The first attribute of a point is a MAL::Integer, being the degree of the polynomial; the second attribute is either a MAL::Float or a MAL::Double, being the coefficient of the term.

mal:composite.name: RangeConversion
mal:composite.comment: The RangeConversion structure holds a range for a one-way conversion to convert between a continuous range to a discrete value. A range is defined as from this point up to, but not including, the next point.

mal:field.name: points
mal:field.comment: The first attribute in each pair is the raw range, and the second attribute is the converted value.
